title: Juicy Midnight German Coconut Stir-fry
description: A floral, juicy German dish featuring desiccated coconut that satisfies midnight cravings with a touch of low-sodium-friendly flavors.

ingredients.name: Minced Garlic
ingredients.notes: For garlic breath, use a food processor or mince finely

ingredients.name: Fresh Herbs (optional, such as Thyme or Rosemary)

instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F and prepare a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Season the chicken pieces lightly with salt and pepper. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken pieces, skin-side down first, cooking until golden brown on both sides (about 4-5 minutes per side). Remove from skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add minced garlic and red pepper flakes; sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. If using fresh herbs, stir them in now.
Return chicken to skillet along with desiccated coconut. Deglaze with soy sauce by pouring it into the pan and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Cover partially with a lid or aluminum foil and bake for 20-25 minutes at 375°F until chicken is fully cooked through, ensuring that the chicken pieces are moist and flavorful.
Once done, remove from heat and let rest for a few minutes before serving.
